title: ERP transformation key to ensuring pharma manufacturing continuity: Experts
description:
Modernising pharma through enterprise resource planning (ERP) transformation replaces vulnerable legacy systems with a single source of truth, ensuring uninterrupted manufacturing continuity, according to experts.
"This digital evolution gives life sciences companies the agility and data integrity needed to seamlessly meet strict regulatory requirements," Mandar Ghatnekar, Chief Technology Officer, Biocon, said while addressing the 15th edition of the Pharma IT Summit Mumbai 2026 organised by Exito Media Concepts earlier in the week.
Speakers from top pharmaceutical companies, who attended the summit, also advocated for the need for human review of GenAI outputs, particularly in a good practice (GxP) environment.
